blocks.text: Statistical model banane ke kai steps (qadam) hain. Aayein unhein ek ek kar ke dekhein:
Step 1: Masla tay karein (Define the Problem)

Pehle masla samajhna zaroori hai. Misal: agar grocery ke kharche ki prediction (pehle se andaza) karni hai to jaanna hoga ke kaunse factors (wajahein) kharcha barhate hain (maslan family size, location ya income).

Phir masle se related (juda hua) data jama karte hain. Hamari misal mein pichhle kharche ki aadatein, ghar ke logon ki ginti aur grocery ke kharche par asar dalne wale doosre factors ka data jama karenge.

Masle aur data ko dekh kar algorithm chunte hain. Algorithms woh tareeqe hain jin se model banta hai. Mashhoor algorithms linear regression aur logistic regression hain, jo isi hisse mein aage parhenge.
Step 4: Model train karein (Train the Model)
Phir model ko data se train kiya jata hai, yani model data se seekhta hai ta ke predictions kar sake.
Aakhir mein naye data se model ko test kiya jata hai (aazmaya jata hai) ke woh kitna achha kaam karta hai. Yeh step bohat aham hai ta ke yaqeen ho ke model achhi predictions karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Linear regression jaisa basic statistical model banane ke steps bataiye: data collection, training aur evaluation (jaanch) samait. (Long question 2)
blocks.explanation: Sawal aur variables tay karein (phal ke stall mein customers X aur kamai Y). Reliable (bharose wala) data jama karein, saaf karein aur graph par dekhein ke relation (taluq) seedhi line jaisa lagta hai ya nahi. Linear regression chunein aur train karein: data par fit hone wala slope aur intercept nikalein (yahan Earnings = 100 + 40 × Customers). Naye data par prediction ko asal se mila kar check karein (28 customers: andaza 1,220, asal 1,250, error −30) aur error ya accuracy metrics istemal karein. Phir nateeja samjhein aur naya data aane par model update karein.

items: Paanch steps: masla tay karna, data jama karna, algorithm chunna, train karna, naye data par test karna.
